notes.subject: נדבה
notes.rationale: Some render 'freewill offering' (a category), others adverbially 'freely' modifying the vow; here 'presen bilong laik bilong yu yet' keeps the voluntariness

notes.subject: שפתיך
notes.rationale: Hebrew 'your lips' rendered 'maus bilong yu' (mouth) in the second half בפיך also mouth — lip/mouth distinction flattened

translation: Olgeta samting i kamap auset long maus bilong yu, yu ken lukautim gut na wokim em, olsem promis bilong yu yet we yu bin givim long Yahwe Elohim bilong yu, olsem presen bilong laik bilong yu yet, we yu bin tokim long maus bilong yu.

presen bilong laik bilong yu yet
